Радио работает через MeshCore: личные со: The radio runs on MeshCore: direct messages are encrypted with node keys, the public chat is the standard Public channel. The old MM/1 key is kept for rollback and is not used in MeshCore.
RSSI — только сила сигнала: направления: RSSI is only signal strength: it gives neither direction nor distance. Bearing: walk and watch “warmer / colder”. Phone Bluetooth addresses change, so the device count is approximate.
Две платы в 2–5 м: одна — маяк, другая —: Two boards 2–5 m apart: one is the beacon, the other the receiver. The receiver sees motion between the boards, but not where people are. A motionless person is barely noticeable.
Смена режима перезапускает устройство. С: Changing the mode restarts the device. Messages, contacts, maps and settings are kept, and the node key stays the same. After the restart the Wi-Fi access point must be turned on again; it will have a new password. On the M9 screen the mode is chosen in the first 5 seconds after power-on.
